name: Potiphar
bio:
Potiphar is an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian who bought Joseph as a slave after his brothers sold him (Genesis 37:36; 39:1). Seeing that the LORD was with Joseph and prospered everything he did, Potiphar came to trust him greatly, putting him in charge of his household and placing everything he owned in his hands (Genesis 39:2-6).

However, Potiphar's wife repeatedly tried to seduce Joseph; when he firmly refused, she grew angry and falsely accused him of attempted assault. Potiphar, believing his wife's account without investigation, had Joseph thrown into prison (Genesis 39:7-20). Though Potiphar's judgment was unfair, based only on one side of the story, the LORD remained with Joseph even in prison, showing him favor there and ultimately working out a far greater plan.
